item.title: Unexpected Reboot During Autopilot ESP — Diagnosing and Fixing the Device Already Enrolled Error
item.description: An unexpected reboot mid-Autopilot provisioning was causing a misleading Device Already Enrolled error on re-enrollment. Here is what caused it and how it was fixed.

item.title: SSPR Not Showing on Windows Lock Screen — The GPO Conflict Nobody Checked
item.description: How a security hardening GPO silently blocked SSPR on the Windows lock screen for over a year — and how investigating the right Group Policy settings and their related registry keys finally solved it.

item.title: About
item.description:
Hi, I am Ali Norouzi — an IT pro based in Brisbane, Australia, specialising in endpoint management, Intune, Azure, SOE and EUC.

I created aliendpoint.dev to share real-world guides, scripts, and insights from day to day challenges on production environments.

I write about Microsoft Intune, Entra ID, Windows SOE, Autopilot, PowerShell, and modern workplace technology.

The views and opinions expressed on this site are my own and do not reflect those of my employer or any organisation I am affiliated with. All content is provided as-is for informational purposes only. Any actions taken based on the information published here are done at your own risk.
